title: Unit 6: Discover our country, discover our world
content:
My parents and I are on holiday in Suzhou! This morning, we visited Suzhou Museum. It's a place where we can learn about the history, culture and art of Suzhou. We were walking on a bridge when I took this photo. Look at the wall and its reflection on the water. It's breathtaking!

Today, my parents and I visited Suzhou's 'Four Famous Gardens'. I liked Lion Grove Garden best. It's over 680 years old and it's on the UNESCO World Heritage List! In the garden, there were rocks that looked like lions in different poses. How incredible!

We also went on a boat ride through the river in Shantang Street. It's a place where there are houses over a thousand years old. They looked so special! When we were cruising along the river, some friendly local people waved at us.

Suzhou is famous for its unique scenery. Many poets wrote poems about this place. I really enjoy discovering the amazing places in our country. We should all value these places and do our part to protect them.

This is the second day of our trip in Beijing. Dad is interested in space, so we visited the China Space Museum early in the morning. It's a place where people can learn all about China's space developments and fascinating programmes.

The museum is very big, so there is a lot to see. My favourite activity was taking a VR tour of a real space station. The VR tour was a new experience to me. Everything looked so real and I felt like an astronaut. What a blast!

Instead of going sightseeing in the city, we decided to walk on a glass bridge today. The bridge was high up on a mountain, so we had to climb the mountain first. Although it was tiring, the scenery was great! When I was walking on the bridge, I looked down at the valley. It was a big mistake! My legs started to shake and I couldn't breathe. Mum had to hold my hand for the rest of the way. It turns out I'm afraid of heights, but I'm still glad that I gave it a try!

supplementary.learningElementsMarkdown:
### 📌 Inserted Learning & Skill Elements

- **Values Education:** **Love our country**  
  Appreciating China's profound cultural relics, landscape wonders, and aerospace achievements.

- **Tourism & Experience Prompts:**  
  - If you need to choose a special place in China and introduce it to a tourist, what place will you choose? Why?  
  - Where have you travelled before? What did you do there? What did you learn?

- **Our Culture & National Security Education (National security education: outer space security):**  
  **Space Day of China**  
  Space Day of China is on 24 April every year. Our country works hard to keep the outer space systems safe and ensure that they work well for space exploration. We should be proud of our country's successes in space developments. We can take action by learning more about China's space programmes, sharing the knowledge with others and supporting our country's progress in outer space developments. Which area would you like to know more about, the development of spacecraft, space food or something else? How can you find out more information about it? How are you going to share it with others?
